questions.answer: Ms. Lee had been a designer before she left the company.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 사용하여 완전한 문장으로 영작하시오.
Ms. Lee는 그녀가 그 회사를 떠나기 전에 디자이너였었다. (before)
 ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 회사를 떠난 것(과거)보다 디자이너였던 것이 더 이전의 상태이므로 대과거 had been을 사용합니다.

questions.answer: They had lived in this neighborhood for two decades before I moved here last month.
questions.explanation: 내가 이사 온 것(과거)보다 이전부터 이어진 계속을 나타내므로 과거완료 had lived를 사용합니다. 20년은 two decades로, 숫자는 영어로 씁니다.

questions.answer: I had not liked art before I met her.
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말을 괄호 안의 단어를 활용하여 대과거 시제가 포함된 완전한 영어 문장으로 쓰시오.
Sujin is one of my classmates. We have known each other since last spring. She loves to paint pictures. In fact, 내가 그녀를 만나기 전까지는 난 미술을 좋아하지 않았었다. (like, art, before, meet)
 ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 그녀를 만난 것(과거)보다 이전의 상태를 나타내므로 대과거 had not liked를 사용합니다.

questions.answer:
(1) I had left my ticket at home.
(2) I had forgotten my keys.
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (1), (2)를 각각 완전한 문장으로 영작하시오.
A: Did you enjoy the movie last night?
B: Well, it's a long story. I got on the train, but I realized that (1)나는 나의 표를 집에 두고 왔었다. A: Did you go back home?
B: Yes, I did, but I couldn't enter because (2)나는 열쇠를 잊고 나왔었다.
(1) ____________________________________________________
(2) ____________________________________________________
 ※ 각각 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 기차에 탄 것과 집에 못 들어간 것(과거)보다 표를 두고 온 것과 열쇠를 잊은 것이 더 이전이므로 과거완료 had left, had forgotten을 사용합니다.

questions.answer:
(1) had practiced
(2) had played
(3) had come
questions.question:
[보기] become, play, come, practice, get
다음 <보기>에 주어진 동사 중 알맞은 것을 골라 어법상 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 글의 빈칸 (1)~(3)을 완성하시오. (단, 동사는 한 번씩만 사용할 것)
Let me introduce my favorite tennis player Nadia. Because she (1)______________ hard for many years, she was chosen for the national team at 18. After she (2)______________ tennis in Spain for 5 years, she moved to France in 2015. When French tennis fans heard that she (3)______________ to France, they were very excited.
questions.explanation: 세 빈칸 모두 과거의 특정 사건(선발됨, 이사함, 소식 들음)보다 더 이전의 일이므로 과거완료를 사용합니다. (1) 연습한 것 had practiced, (2) 활동한 것 had played, (3) 이동한 것 had come입니다.

questions.answer: (A) forgot (B) had planned (C) arrived (D) had (E) gone
questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A)~(E)에 들어갈 말을 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 쓰시오.

Last Sunday, I (A)__________ about the movie that I (B)__________ to watch with my sister the night before. When I (C)__________ at the theater that afternoon, my sister (D)__________ already (E)__________ inside.

<조건>
1. 주어진 동사(go, plan, arrive, forget, leave, walk)를 문맥에 맞게 적절히 변형하여 쓸 것
2. 빈칸 (A)~(E)에 각각 단어 1개 또는 2개를 쓸 것
questions.explanation: 빈칸 (A)는 지난 일요일에 일어난 일이므로 과거시제 forgot을 씁니다. (B)는 그 전날 밤 계획한 것이므로 과거보다 더 이전을 나타내는 과거완료 had planned를 씁니다. (C)는 도착한 시점(과거)이므로 arrived, (D)(E)는 그 도착 이전에 이미 일어난 일이므로 과거완료 had already gone을 씁니다.

questions.answer: (1) I had left my ticket at home. (2) I had forgotten my key.
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (1), (2)를 각각 완전한 문장으로 영작하시오.

A: Did you have a good time at the concert last night?
B: Well, it's a long story. I got to the station, but I realized that (1)나는 나의 표를 집에 두고 왔었다.
A: Did you go back home?
B: Yes, I did, but I couldn't open the door because (2)나는 열쇠를 깜빡 잊고 나왔었다.

(1) ____________________________________________________
(2) ____________________________________________________
questions.explanation: 과거의 어느 시점보다 더 이전에 일어난 일이므로 과거완료(had+과거분사)를 사용합니다. (1)은 had left, (2)는 had forgotten으로 씁니다.

questions.answer: (1) had left (2) had forgotten (3) had finished
questions.question:
[보기] leave finish forget

다음 <보기>에 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하시오.

A: Did you have a good time at the concert last night?
B: Well, it's a long story. I got to the station, but I realized that I (1)__________ __________ my ticket at home.
A: Did you go back home?
B: Yes, I did, but I couldn't open the door because I (2)__________ __________ my key.
A: So what did you do?
B: I hurried to the concert hall. But when I got there, the show (3)__________ already __________.
questions.explanation: 모두 과거의 특정 시점보다 더 이전에 일어난 일을 나타내므로 과거완료(had+과거분사)를 씁니다. (1) had left, (2) had forgotten, (3) had finished입니다.

questions.answer: (1) arrived (2) had already arrived / had arrived (3) looked (4) had forgotten (5) had forgotten
questions.question:
[보기] have, to, stop, already, look, leave, be, start, use, arrive, forget, of

다음 <보기>에 주어진 단어를 사용하여 글의 시간의 순서에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오. (단, 단어 형태 변형 가능, 중복 사용 가능)

Last Sunday, I went on a picnic with my best friend at the park. I was really happy because it was my first outing in a long time.
In the morning, it was raining heavily. I (1)_________ late because of the flooded roads. When I got to the park, he (2)______________________. Luckily he wasn't upset and waved at me. I found a nice spot to sit and eat. Unfortunately for me, when I (3)________________ into my bag, I discovered that I (4)________________ my lunch box at home. Feeling embarrassed, I told him that I (5)________________ my lunch box. He kindly shared his food with me.
questions.explanation: (1) 과거의 도착이므로 arrived. (2) 내가 도착하기 전 그가 먼저 와 있던 것이므로 과거완료 had (already) arrived(그가 손을 흔든 것으로 보아 떠난 것이 아니라 먼저 도착함). (3) 과거의 동작 looked. (4)(5) 도착·발견 시점보다 더 이전 일이므로 과거완료 had forgotten.

questions.answer: A drone is what I got.
questions.question:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 바르게 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

A: What did you get for your birthday?
B: (got, I, what, a, is, drone).
acceptedAnswers: A drone is what I got.
A drone is what I got

questions.answer: I couldn't understand what she said.
questions.question:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 바르게 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

A: Did you understand the teacher's explanation?
B: Not really. (said, she, I, understand, what, couldn't).
acceptedAnswers: I couldn't understand what she said.
I couldn't understand what she said
I could not understand what she said.

questions.answer: This is exactly what I wanted.
questions.question:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 바르게 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

A: Is this the jacket you were looking for?
B: Yes! (exactly, this, wanted, what, is, I).
acceptedAnswers: This is exactly what I wanted.
This is exactly what I wanted

questions.answer: What he told me
questions.question:
다음 문장을 관계대명사 what을 이용하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 바꾸시오.

<보기> I love the thing that you gave me. → I love what you gave me.

The thing that he told me was shocking.
→ _______ was shocking.

questions.answer: what you want to have
questions.question:
다음 문장을 관계대명사 what을 이용하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 바꾸시오.

<보기> I love the thing that you gave me. → I love what you gave me.

Tell me the thing that you want to have for lunch.
→ Tell me _______ for lunch.

questions.answer: What surprised me most
questions.question:
다음 문장을 관계대명사 what을 이용하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 바꾸시오.

<보기> I love the thing that you gave me. → I love what you gave me.

The thing that surprised me most was his answer.
→ _______ was his answer.

questions.answer: What the victims received
questions.question:
다음 문장을 관계대명사 what을 이용하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 바꾸시오.

<보기> I love the thing that you gave me. → I love what you gave me.

The things that the victims received were not enough.
→ _______ were not enough.

questions.answer: What she is most proud of
questions.question:
다음 문장을 관계대명사 what을 이용하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 바꾸시오.

<보기> I love the thing that you gave me. → I love what you gave me.

The thing that she is most proud of is her patience.
→ _______ is her patience.
acceptedAnswers: What she is most proud of
